newsitem.title: USA: American Bio Medica gets FDA clearance.
newsitem.headline: American Bio Medica gets FDA clearance.

text.p: American Bio Medica Corp said Wednesday that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration cleared the company's 510 (k) submission for its Rapid Drug Screen drug test.
American Bio Medica also announced that it will initiate marketing efforts of its Rapid Drug Screen to the clinical sector.
The FDA's clearance of the company's 510 (k) enables American Bio Medica to expand its marketing efforts to include hospitals, emergency rooms, and physicians.
Rapid Drug Screen is a one-step diagnostic test which determines the presence or absence of THC (marijuana), cocaine, PCP, amphetamines, and opiates in three to five minutes.
